verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a Torch developer portal with documented Case Status and FOIA APIs, sandbox access and production keys, so an API-spec story applies to it. However, no evidence item mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Having APIs and onboarding docs is adjacent and does not show a spec can be downloaded.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
